name: Skills
description: Discover agent skills — named bundles of instructions, context, and tools. Pick command='list' to render an index, or command='read' for one full skill. Sources may be directories such as w/skills or v/skills, individual named paths such as v/skills/models, or content-addressed assets. Read-only — author with covia_write or asset_store.

sources.description: Skill sources — directory paths, individual skill paths, or asset refs. Default: ["w/skills", "v/skills"]. Earlier sources shadow same-named later skills.

name.description: read only: a skill name from the index, looked up across sources.

ref.description: read only: direct skill address (a/<hash>, v/skills/<x>, w/skills/<x>) — alternative to name.

output.description: list → the skill index text (one '- name — description' line per skill), or null when no skills exist. read → {name, description, body?, tools, skills?, context?, path} — skills contains child source refs contributed while loaded; body is present when the skill has content (a contentless skill is a pure toolset).
